q: How do I calculate the carbon footprint of aluminium composite panel per square metre?
title: ACP carbon footprint per sq m
short: Weigh the two aluminium skins and the polyethylene or mineral core per square metre and multiply each by its supplier figure. Add coil coating, lamination and line energy, then divide the plant's energy by square metres dispatched.
audience: Aluminium composite panel makers and facade contractors

ul: Aluminium coil for the two skins, by weight.
Paint, adhesive film and protective film.

p: Report per square metre with skin thickness and core type. The aluminium skins usually carry most of the footprint.

example.title: Worked example: ACP unit per sq m (one month)
lines: Plant total: 51,900 / 100,000 = 0.519 kg CO2 per sq m
Add aluminium skins and core for the full figure
example.note: Inputs are illustrative; use your own bills and production records.

senseible: Senseible reads the plant's electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and fuel invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record, the plant-level input to a per-unit figure. Bought-in materials go to the supplier evidence trail; product reports are self-declared drafts.
